items.description: Owner-only bounded management of an abnormal verification task, not a recursive asynchronous task. Each reliably persisted result, including insufficient evidence, consumes request_id; the same ID replays its historical result without re-inspecting. A new ID is needed for fresh evidence. Checks registered local execution exclusion and durable finish separately; may close only the verification task, never the original business task or its claims. Missing/unregistered runtime proof retains protection. No force/evidence flags, waiting, implicit retry or production source approval.

Explicit asynchronous inspection of durable publication evidence for an unresolved market task. Reads fixed SQLite publication versions, receipts and projections; missing receipt is insufficient evidence, not proof of failure. The separate check never publishes, changes heads or releases the original task claims. A prior all-recorded conclusion can bind a new request without a new inspection. Inspect publication_check via get_task_progress. Corrupt evidence and interrupted inspections retain protection; no caller approval or force flags. This ready interface does not make the official data source production-ready.

blocking_reasons: STOP_EVIDENCE_NOT_VERIFIED
items.description: Explicit asynchronous stopping-evidence inspection of a task awaiting verification. Admission preserves original claims. The installed verifier can prove an audited revision-zero task never started using verified SQLite facts and conditional exclusion of a later claim. Started or unsupported executions remain STOP_EVIDENCE_NOT_VERIFIED; no caller assertion, PID absence or old run identity can unlock a task. Inspect the separate check conclusion via get_task_progress.

blocking_reasons: GAP_BASIS_NOT_VERIFIED (#54/#46/#71: no trusted source-gap verifier)
items.description: Explicit asynchronous verification of a proven local coverage gap in one published QFQ daily version. The caller names only symbol/day/[start,end]; the subject head is frozen at acceptance and re-checked at decision commit. Decisions come only from the installed trusted source-gap verifier; source limitation or unavailability never produces a proven gap, and a decision never triggers update/backfill by itself. The installed production verifier is blocked (GAP_BASIS_NOT_VERIFIED) until the source gates lift.
